name: Reel n Creel
description: 53 fish modelled on real species, each living in the water that suits it, in four sizes. Six fishing rods, each hooking live fish of its own size classes, and a fight you read from the bend of the rod: hold to reel, let go to give line. Fish meat, one bucket for every fish, a chance of treasure with a landed fish, and fishermen who buy your catch. Breed fish with seagrass and watch their spawn hatch. Vanilla's fishing rod works as it always has, with a new 3D look.
